mapper.select: SELECT C.CUST_ID as "custId", C.CUST_NM as "custName", C.CUST_TEL as "custTel", C.CUST_MEMO as "custMemo", C.IN_DT as "inDt" FROM CUST C JOIN STORE S ON C.STORE_ID = S.STORE_ID WHERE S.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY C.IN_DT DESC

SELECT R.RESERV_ID AS "reservId", C.CUST_ID AS "custId", C.CUST_NM AS "custName", C.CUST_TEL AS "custTel", C.CUST_MEMO AS "custMemo", CO.COURSE_NM AS "courseName", R.START_TIME AS "startTime", R.END_TIME AS "endTime", R.RESERV_STAT AS "reservStat" FROM RESERVATION R JOIN CUST C ON R.CUST_ID = C.CUST_ID JOIN COURSE CO ON R.COURSE_ID = CO.COURSE_ID JOIN STORE S ON R.STORE_ID = S.STORE_ID WHERE S.USER_ID = #{userId} AND TRUNC(R.RESERV_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) ORDER BY R.START_TIME ASC
